The Router's visual identification of this fusion is the primary truth. The 'text_gibberish' severity (2.5) is also accurate; the Image Text Auditor found no readable text, confirming the gibberish. The 'perspective_distortion' (1.5) is minor and acceptable for background elements.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class ('slot, one-armed bandit') with high confidence (logit 7.77), overriding the geometric deviations (missing lever, slanted console).
